context.notes: Template context for `title` when it is a TemplateRef. Angular-only.

id.notes: `id` is a native attribute on the host, so the wrapper doesn't need to declare it.

schematic.todo: `(selected)` is deprecated. Use `(openChange)`, which emits a boolean, or `(accordionItemToggled)`, which emits the CustomEvent with `detail.open`.

selected-source.cca: Emits { id, expanded } from toggleExpanded(), i.e. on user click or an explicit toggleExpanded() call. Setting [expanded] doesn't emit.
selected-source.wc: cds-accordion-item-toggled fires after a user gesture with detail.open. Setting `open` doesn't fire it.
selected-source.notes: The web component event matches v6 semantics more closely than v7's observeAttributes(['open']), which also emits on programmatic changes. The one gap is a toggleExpanded() call, handled by the toggle-method entry.

toggle-method.wc: No public toggle method. Setting `open` doesn't dispatch cds-accordion-item-toggled.
toggle-method.notes: To keep v6 behaviour exactly, the derived method also emits `selected` and `openChange` after flipping `open`.

id-default.notes: The only v6 use of the generated id was the `selected` payload. With no id set, the payload's `id` is now ''.
